manifest.distribution: To accompany the Hugging Face dataset; not embedded in the code repository.

verification: The independent original full-token audit contains exactly the train_drop and val_common union.
Every stored token count equals the independently audited untruncated tokenizer count.
Every FP16 token-time tensor matches the independent word-derived timing audit.
Every condition file, text tensor and token-time tensor is bound by SHA256.
loader_policy: New raw conditions require echo-g-complete-text-provenance-v1; historical frozen conditions require the manifest and this externally pinned SHA256. An explicitly supplied manifest always requires matching file identity.
